## Description

Rebuild / (src/Host.Api/PublicSite/Index.cshtml) to the 6 Nov home: hero with the two CTAs and the product picture (today screen, Assist draft, payment and WhatsApp reminder cards), a clinic day timeline, the feature grid with "Compare plans", the Medvya Assist section, "Who it's for" by practice size, "Your patients get an app too", "Live in a day. We move your data for you.", the trust strip linking /trust, a short pricing teaser linking /pricing and the FAQ. Product pictures use only the synthetic cast (docs/00-overview/personas.md). The customer-stories block is not shown until real, permitted quotes exist. Prices appear only from the approved plan list used by /pricing (MDV-P5-050).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given JavaScript is off, when the home page loads, then every section renders and the FAQ opens with details/summary.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the home page, when it is checked, then it shows no invented customer quote, metric or certification claim.
- [ ] **AC3.** Lighthouse mobile performance and accessibility stay at 90 or more; axe is clean in en, hi and ar.
- [ ] **AC4.** Every string comes from packages/i18n in en, hi and ar; Arabic is right to left.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
